name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Build and Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.22', '1.23']

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}

      - name: Build
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Test
        run: go test ./... -v

      - name: Check formatting
        run: |
          unformatted=$(gofmt -l .)
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "Files not formatted:"
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi
